remarks: Owners say it's time to Sell!  Listed here is approximately 2.5 acres of contiguous vacant land situated in the Lewiston-Porter Region of Niagara County. These five adjoining lots are part of the Scenic Niagara Trail area, which includes grape vine farms, apple orchards, and regional historical sites. On the immediate north side of this parcel are newly constructed residential single-family homes. Centrally located with close proximity to Niagara Frontier Golf Club to the west of this lot, which is literally in walking distance just down the street! With that said, the Village of Lewiston is within a 10-minute drive away, and to the north, enjoy Lake Ontario and Four Mile Creek State Park. Water and electric are at the roadside, and this area is zoned Rural Residential, making it ready for your next building adventure. All five parcels are being merged into one lot for the assessment year of 2027.  There are no wetlands present, so bring your building plans, and make a solid investment here.  Seller financing is available with good credit, and a decent deposit.
